cohort: 666 pregnant women, 69 with GDM and 597 without GDM, who gave birth at Sunshine Ronghe Hospital between August 2017 and May 2018
finding: Newborns of mothers with GDM had a significantly higher incidence of abnormal hearing screening results compared to newborns of mothers without GDM.
mod_finding: In both GDM and non-GDM groups, there was no significant difference in hearing screening results between newborns delivered vaginally and those delivered by cesarean section.
